title: MLOps Engineer
description: A production-focused roadmap for MLOps: ML foundations, experiment tracking, data/model versioning, CI/CD, serving, monitoring, and cloud deployment.

tree.name: ML, Python, Linux, and Git Foundations
tree.description: Start with enough machine learning and systems knowledge to package models, test code, and reason about production failures.

resources.title: MLOps GitHub Actions CI/CD Tutorial (Krish Naik)

children.name: ML Lifecycle Basics
children.description: Understand training data, validation, leakage, metrics, reproducibility, model artifacts, model cards, and release criteria.

children.name: Python Packaging and Testing
children.description: Create clean project layouts, virtual environments, requirements, unit tests, lint checks, CLI scripts, and reproducible configs.

tree.name: Experiment Tracking and Versioning
tree.description: Track experiments, datasets, model artifacts, parameters, metrics, lineage, and registry promotion decisions.

resources.title: Complete End-to-End Deep Learning Project with MLflow, DVC, and Deployment (Krish Naik)

children.name: MLflow Tracking and Registry
children.description: Log metrics, params, artifacts, models, environments, and promotion stages so every experiment is auditable.

children.name: DVC Data and Model Versioning
children.description: Version datasets and model files outside Git, configure remotes, reproduce pipelines, and recover previous experiment states.

children.name: Practice: Reproducible Training Run
children.description: Train a small model, log metrics to MLflow, version data with DVC, rerun from a clean clone, and compare two model versions.

tree.name: CI/CD, Containers, and Model Serving
tree.description: Automate testing, image builds, model validation, deployment, rollback, and API serving for machine learning systems.

resources.title: MLOps Dockerized Flask CI/CD with GitHub Actions (Krish Naik)

children.name: Docker and FastAPI Serving
children.description: Package inference code, expose prediction APIs, add health checks, write request schemas, and load model artifacts safely.

children.name: CI/CD for ML Validation
children.description: Automate unit tests, data checks, model smoke tests, container scans, registry publishing, staging deploys, and approval gates.

tree.name: Cloud Deployment and Monitoring
tree.description: Operate ML services with cloud infrastructure, observability, drift checks, scheduled retraining, cost controls, and incident playbooks.

children.name: Kubernetes and Managed ML Platforms
children.description: Learn when to use Kubernetes, managed endpoints, batch jobs, queues, autoscaling, secrets, and infrastructure-as-code.

children.name: Monitoring, Drift, and Reliability
children.description: Track service health, latency, prediction distributions, data drift, model quality, error budgets, and rollback triggers.

children.name: Project: Production ML Pipeline
children.description: Build a model service with DVC data versioning, MLflow tracking, GitHub Actions tests, Docker image build, API deploy, and monitoring notes.
